scenarios.title: A｜正常完成
scenarios.setting: 在“网上值机”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“正常完成”。

turns.text: Hello. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想办理入住、出行或离店手续，会怎样说明来意？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to check in online for my flight tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to check in online for my flight tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: I’m trying to complete online check-in.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m trying to complete online check-in.
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Could you help me with online check-in?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you help me with online check-in?
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: I want to check in for tomorrow’s flight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I want to check in for tomorrow’s flight.
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: I want do online check-in.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to check in online for my flight tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: “want”后需要“to”；这里可以直接用动词短语“check in online”，不用再加“do”。

turns.text: Of course. Online check-in is available now. Do you have your booking reference?

turns.prompt: 关于「网上值机」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yes, it’s AB5824.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, it’s AB5824.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Yes. I also have my passport with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I also have my passport with me.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Sure. What information will I need?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. What information will I need?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

turns.text: You’ll need your booking reference and passport details.

turns.prompt: 你想确认线上值机需要填写哪些证件信息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do I need to enter my passport number?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to enter my passport number?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Do I need to provide the expiration date as well?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to provide the expiration date as well?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Should my name match my passport exactly?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should my name match my passport exactly?
feedback.explanation: “exactly”强调信息吻合或需要精确确认，适合核对具体细节。

choices.text: Can I check in using my phone?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I check in using my phone?
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

turns.text: Yes. Make sure the name and passport information match your travel document.

turns.prompt: 你想询问填完值机信息后的下一步，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, I’ve entered everything. What’s the next step?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ve entered everything. What’s the next step?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: I’ve finished that part. Do I choose my seat now?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve finished that part. Do I choose my seat now?
feedback.explanation: 用具体规格或位置回应对方，便于落实选择；上下文已明确时，不必重复整项需求。

choices.text: Great. How do I get my boarding pass?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. How do I get my boarding pass?
feedback.explanation: “how do I get”询问到达方法，方便对方提供路线或交通方式。

turns.text: Once you confirm your seat, you can download your boarding pass.

turns.prompt: 你想了解怎样保存和出示登机牌，会怎么说？

choices.text: Can I save the boarding pass to my phone?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I save the boarding pass to my phone?
feedback.explanation: “boarding pass”指登机牌，区别于预订记录或付款凭证。

choices.text: Do I need to print it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to print it?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Can I use the digital boarding pass at the airport?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I use the digital boarding pass at the airport?
feedback.explanation: “boarding pass”指登机牌，区别于预订记录或付款凭证。

turns.text: Yes, you can use the mobile boarding pass.

turns.prompt: 你想告诉对方自己已经完成值机，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. I’ve completed the check-in.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. I’ve completed the check-in.
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Great. Thank you for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Thank you for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: B｜无法值机
scenarios.setting: 在“网上值机”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“无法值机”。

turns.prompt: 你想办理入住、出行或离店手续，会怎样说明来意？

choices.text: Hi, I’m trying to check in online, but it isn’t working.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m trying to check in online, but it isn’t working.
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: I can’t complete online check-in for my flight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t complete online check-in for my flight.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: The website won’t let me check in.

feedback.naturalExpression: The website won’t let me check in.
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: I’m having trouble checking in online.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m having trouble checking in online.
feedback.explanation: “checking in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: I can’t success the online check-in.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m trying to check in online, but it isn’t working.
feedback.explanation: “success”是名词，“successful”是形容词，不能直接跟在“didn’t / can’t”后作动词；这里可说“didn’t go through”。

turns.prompt: 关于「网上值机」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: It says, “Online check-in unavailable.”

feedback.naturalExpression: It says, “Online check-in unavailable.”
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: It tells me to check in at the airport.

feedback.naturalExpression: It tells me to check in at the airport.
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: I keep getting an error when I enter my passport details.

feedback.naturalExpression: I keep getting an error when I enter my passport details.
feedback.explanation: “an error”指报错提示；说明出现在哪一步，有助于对方排查。

choices.text: It says my booking can’t be checked in online.

feedback.naturalExpression: It says my booking can’t be checked in online.
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

turns.prompt: 你想了解无法线上值机的可能原因，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could there be a problem with my booking?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could there be a problem with my booking?
feedback.explanation: “booking”指预订，酒店、交通和活动中都常用。

choices.text: Is online check-in unavailable for this flight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is online check-in unavailable for this flight?
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Do I need to check in at the airport instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to check in at the airport instead?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Is there anything I need to fix before I go to the airport?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything I need to fix before I go to the airport?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

turns.text: Your booking is fine. Your travel documents need to be checked in person, so you’ll need to use the airport counter.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: So I can still fly as booked?

feedback.naturalExpression: So I can still fly as booked?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Does this mean there’s nothing wrong with my ticket?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does this mean there’s nothing wrong with my ticket?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: How early should I arrive at the airport?

feedback.naturalExpression: How early should I arrive at the airport?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Which counter should I go to?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which counter should I go to?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

turns.text: Yes, your ticket is valid. Please arrive at least three hours before departure.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. Thank you for checking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thank you for checking.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Great. I’ll check in at the airport instead.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll check in at the airport instead.
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

scenarios.title: C｜无法选择座位
scenarios.setting: 在“网上值机”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“无法选择座位”。

turns.prompt: 你想办理入住、出行或离店手续，会怎样说明来意？

choices.text: Hi, I’m checking in online, but I can’t choose a seat.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m checking in online, but I can’t choose a seat.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: The seat map isn’t showing any available seats.

feedback.naturalExpression: The seat map isn’t showing any available seats.
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: I’m able to check in, but seat selection isn’t available.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m able to check in, but seat selection isn’t available.
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Why can’t I choose my seat?

feedback.naturalExpression: Why can’t I choose my seat?
feedback.explanation: 用具体规格或位置回应对方，便于落实选择；上下文已明确时，不必重复整项需求。

choices.text: There is no seat can choose.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m checking in online, but I can’t choose a seat.
feedback.explanation: 可说“There are no seats available to choose from”；原句把“there is”和“can choose”直接拼在了一起。

turns.text: Let me take a look. Some seats are currently being held for airport assignment.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: Does that mean I’ll be assigned a seat at the airport?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does that mean I’ll be assigned a seat at the airport?
feedback.explanation: “does that mean”根据刚得到的信息核对含义，给对方纠正理解的机会。

choices.text: Will I definitely get a seat before boarding?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I definitely get a seat before boarding?
feedback.explanation: “boarding”指登机或上车过程，区别于航班、车次实际出发。

choices.text: Can I still request a window or aisle seat?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I still request a window or aisle seat?
feedback.explanation: “aisle seat”指靠过道的座位，可直接用来表达选座偏好。

choices.text: Is there any way to choose a seat now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any way to choose a seat now?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

turns.text: You can complete check-in now, and a seat will be assigned later.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: When will I find out which seat I’ve been assigned?

feedback.naturalExpression: When will I find out which seat I’ve been assigned?
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: Will it appear on my boarding pass later?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will it appear on my boarding pass later?
feedback.explanation: “boarding pass”指登机牌，区别于预订记录或付款凭证。

choices.text: Could I ask for an aisle seat at the check-in counter?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I ask for an aisle seat at the check-in counter?
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Should I check the app again later?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I check the app again later?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

turns.text: Yes. You can check again later or ask at the airport.

turns.prompt: 关于「网上值机」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, I’ll complete check-in without choosing a seat.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll complete check-in without choosing a seat.
feedback.explanation: “check-in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: That’s fine. I’ll ask at the airport.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. I’ll ask at the airport.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Got it. Thanks for explaining.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thanks for explaining.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。
